pythonFunction.name: check_outage_status
pythonFunction.description:
Checks whether a gas outage or planned maintenance is recorded for a ZIP code. Works for guests,
identified and authenticated callers. Before calling this tool, speak a brief conversational
pacing phrase while it runs.

Args:
    zip: Five-digit ZIP code of the service address (REQUIRED).
    tenant: Injected by the system from tenant_id; leave empty.

Returns:
    dict with ok, outage_active, incident_id, eta and planned_maintenance (start and end);
    sets the outage_active variable.
